name: Agentic RAG for Dummies
summary: Modular Agentic RAG built with LangGraph: hierarchical indexing, conversation memory and human-in-the-loop query clarification.
description: Build an agentic RAG system in minimal Python: hierarchical parent/child indexing, a four-stage query workflow (conversation summary, clarification, multi-agent map-reduce retrieval, answer aggregation), self-correction and context compression. Comes as a step-by-step notebook or a modular project that runs Ollama-first and adapts to OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini, with Qdrant hybrid search, a Gradio chat UI, Langfuse observability and RAGAS evaluation.
contains: hierarchical indexing: small child chunks for search, large parent chunks for context
four-stage query workflow: summary, clarification, multi-agent retrieval, aggregation
self-correction, context compression and Langfuse observability; RAGAS evaluation notebook
two paths: notebook tutorial (agentic_rag, evaluation, pdf_to_markdown) or modular project app
Ollama-first, adaptable to OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini; Qdrant vector store; Gradio chat UI
